summary.text: Grey Cloud Battle Puppet is an immortal battlefield killer move of grey clouds on the northern icy plain. A destroyed Gu Immortal head can scatter into grey clouds and reform.

claims.text: Carriage-sized grey clouds coil around Fang Yuan on the northern icy plain while nine Gu Immortals and a dragon immemorial desolate beast, all veiled in the same grey covering, close the ambush; he reads it as a battlefield immortal killer move he has not seen before and judges it to be mostly cloud path.

Inside the field the controllers say that as long as grey cloud battle puppet remains, he cannot escape. A thin grey layer on his body cuts his speed while it boosts a pursuing rank seven. After he spends Man as Before and dark assassination on a dual-spear fighter, that Gu Immortal credits Lady Earth Mother as the move’s creator, and Fang Yuan, on first hearing the name, calls grey cloud battle puppet a fierce battlefield killer move.

The rock dragon puppet’s aura is real, yet it cannot show full rank eight battle strength: the battlefield has no core rank eight Immortal Gu, and the snowman and rockman casters sit far underground, feeding Gu worms and immortal essence into puppets no weaker than their own bodies while the real immemorial rock dragon lacks a Gu Immortal’s intelligence to remote-control or freely use Immortal Gu. After talks break the stalemate, the killers dispel grey cloud battle puppet and only the rockman controller’s physical body remains among the clearing clouds.
Days later that rockman, Shi Shi Cheng, is still named as the rank six who controls the immortal battlefield killer move, a mark of the rockmen’s next generation.
The tribes had spent heavily on the same battlefield cast to kill Fang Yuan because his tribulations would consume earth qi and damage their underground home.
